name: OWEB Small Grant Program
summary: Competitive grants of up to $20,000 for on-the-ground watershed restoration in Oregon, such as riparian planting, fish passage and erosion control, reviewed by regional Small Grant Teams through the year.

calls.label: Year-round Small Grant Area applications
calls.note: Accepted year-round until April 15, 2027; application windows set by each Small Grant Team

status.quote: Small Grant Areas accept applications year-round until April 15, 2027.

applicant_types.quote: A grant applicant may be any Tribe, watershed council, soil and water conservation district, not-for-profit corporation, school, Oregon institution of higher education, independent not-for-profit institution of higher education, or political subdivision of this state that is not a state agency.

geography.quote: awards up to $20,000 for on-the-ground restoration projects principally carried out on private lands across Oregon

access.quote: Contact your Small Grant Team Contact for application windows.
